description: The x-axis of the plot represents the number of steps, ranging from 0 to 60000. The y-axis represents the loss, with values ranging from 2 x 10^0 to 1.2 x 10^1. The plot shows four lines representing the loss for Ex1, Ex2, Ex1 Validation Loss, and Ex2 Validation Loss. The Ex1 Loss line starts at a high value and decreases sharply, then levels off. The Ex2 Loss line starts at a lower value than Ex1 Loss and decreases more gradually, then levels off. The Ex1 Validation Loss and Ex2 Validation Loss lines start at lower values than their corresponding Ex1 and Ex2 Loss lines and decrease more gradually, then level off.
